title: Mini Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Shampoo

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, ahaGlycolicAcid, crueltyFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid

descriptionHtml:
✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Frizz✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Increases Shine✓ Hyaluronic Acid
What it is: A shampoo powered by fermented Mirsalehi honey, ceramides, and AHAs to cleanse, hydrate, and support a balanced scalp for stronger, glossier hair.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Shine
- Frizz
- Dryness

Key Benefits:
- Thoroughly cleanses
- Intensely hydrates
- Balances scalp microbiome

Ingredient Callouts: This product is cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This shampoo thoroughly cleanses and intensely hydrates while balancing the scalp's microbiome to reveal stronger, glossier hair.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Twist cap to open.
-Emulsify to create a luxurious lather
-Massage into wet scalp and hair, then rinse.
-For ultimate results, follow with the Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Conditioner and Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hair Mask (each sold separately).
Ingredients+
Aqua (Water/Eau), Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Coco-Glucoside, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate, Parfum (Fragrance), PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Sodium Chloride, Mel (Honey/Miel)*, Ceramide NP, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Propolis Cera (Propolis Wax /Cire de Propolis)*, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Fruit Extract, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Fruit Extract, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Vaccinium Myrtillus Fruit Extract, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Bisabolol, Saccharomyces Ferment Lysate Filtrate, Glycerin, Ethylhexylglycerin, Glyceryl Oleate, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Polyquaternium-10, 1,2-Hexanediol, Saccharum Officinarum (Sugarcane) Extract, Acer Saccharum (Sugar Maple) Extract, Caramel, Glycol Distearate, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Propylene Glycol, Citric Acid, Sorbic Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Salicylic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Benzyl Alcohol, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil**, Coumarin**, Hexyl Cinnamal**, Limonene**, Linalool**, Linalyl Acetate**, Orange 4 (Cl 15510).

*Honey and Propolis sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden.
**Naturally occurring allergens.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
